title: fireanalogs: retrieval-augmented analog prediction of wildfire burn severity from geospatial foundation embeddings
description: Reference implementation for a retrieval-augmented analog framework that uses pre-fire Google Satellite Embedding V1 vectors to retrieve similar historical fires and transfer their observed high-severity behaviour to withheld target fires, with built-surface exposure screening. One command reproduces every reported table, number and figure from the companion data archive on Zenodo.
